episodes.caption: ميرا فتحت محارة… ولقت لولوة تلمع 🦪✨ مثل كنوز الغوّاصين زمان! الحلقة الياية: قلعة فوق راس تل في رأس الخيمة 🏰

episodes.title: ميرا فوق قلعة ضاية
lines: قلعة ضاية في رأس الخيمة، مبنية فوق راس تل عالي!
طلعت الدرج كله، وعقب شفت النخل والبحر… يستاهل التعب!

clips.scene: Morning at Dhayah Fort: a small mud-brick fort with a round tower on a steep rocky hill, a long stone staircase zigzagging up, palm groves at the foot. Mira stands at the foot of the stairs in the foreground, three-quarter view toward the camera, framed from the knees up. 9:16 low angle, clear blue sky.
clips.action: Mira takes a determined breath, rolls her shoulders, grins at the camera, then turns and climbs the first steps with energy. Camera: slow tilt up from Mira along the staircase to the fort on top.
clips.sound: Morning birds, soft breeze, upbeat gentle music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: At the top beside the fort mud wall, safely behind a sturdy chest-high stone wall: a wide view of green palm groves, a flat plain and the sea shining far away. Mira stands slightly out of breath, hands on her knees. 9:16, golden light.
clips.action: Mira straightens up, spreads her arms wide to the view and smiles proudly as the wind moves her abaya softly. Camera: slow half orbit from her face to the panorama.
clips.sound: Hilltop wind, distant birds, triumphant soft music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: كم درجة طلعت ميرا لين قلعة ضاية؟ 😅 بس المنظر من فوق يستاهل! الحلقة الياية: أعلى جبل في الإمارات… والغيوم تحته ☁️

episodes.title: ميرا فوق الغيوم
lines: جبل جيس، أعلى جبل في الإمارات… والغيوم تحت ريولي!
الهوا هني بارد، شربت كرك حار ويا أمي… الله ما أحلاه!

clips.scene: Early morning high on Jebel Jais: layered jagged mountain ridges in purple-blue tones, a soft sea of white clouds filling the valleys below, sun rising. Mira stands at a viewpoint behind a sturdy railing, wide-eyed. 9:16 wide, crisp cool light.
clips.action: Mira leans on the railing and gazes down at the clouds drifting slowly through the valleys. Camera: slow aerial-style push past Mira out over the sea of clouds.
clips.sound: Cool mountain wind, a distant bird, airy calm music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Same viewpoint, close medium shot: Mira and Mama (black abaya and shayla) sit on a bench wrapped in soft shawls, each holding a small plain cup of steaming tea; mountains and clouds behind. 9:16, warm sunrise glow.
clips.action: Mira blows on her steaming cup, takes a sip and snuggles against Mama with a happy shiver. Camera: slow push-in to Mira's cosy smile with steam rising.
clips.sound: Soft wind, gentle cozy music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: ميرا فوق أعلى جبل في الإمارات ☁️ والغيوم تحت ريولها! الحلقة الياية: شلال وسط جبال الفجيرة 💦

episodes.title: ميرا وشلال الوريعة
lines: وادي الوريعة في الفجيرة، أول محمية جبلية في الإمارات!
غمّست يدي في ماي الشلال… بارد وايد، مب طبيعي!

clips.scene: Wadi Wurayah: a rocky canyon of grey-brown boulders and green plants, a small waterfall pouring into a clear emerald pool. Mira stands on a flat rock near the pool, Baba (modest Emirati man, white kandura and ghutra) right behind her. 9:16 wide, bright light with soft mist.
clips.action: Mira looks up at the waterfall, eyes sparkling, as fine mist drifts toward her and a small rainbow shimmers in the spray. Camera: slow tilt up from the pool to the top of the waterfall.
clips.sound: Rushing waterfall, echoing canyon, birds, gentle music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Close medium shot at the edge of the emerald pool: Mira kneels on a smooth flat rock, one hand reaching toward the clear water; tiny fish visible under the surface. 9:16, sparkling reflections.
clips.action: Mira dips her fingers in, flinches at the cold with a laugh, then watches tiny fish swim around her hand. Camera: slow push-in to the water surface and her fingers.
clips.sound: Splashing and trickling water, birds, playful light music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: شلال يركض بين صخور الفجيرة 💦 وميرا جرّبت برودة الماي! الحلقة الياية: قلعة الفجيرة وجبالها 🏰

episodes.title: غمّيضة في قلعة الفجيرة
lines: قلعة الفجيرة من أقدم القلاع في الإمارات، ووراها جبال الحجر.
بين أبراجها المدوّرة لعبنا الغمّيضة أنا وأخوي الصغير!

clips.scene: Fujairah Fort in late afternoon: a mud-brick and stone fort with round and square towers on a low rocky mound, rugged mountains behind, date palms around. Mira stands on the path in the foreground, three-quarter view toward the camera, framed from the knees up. 9:16 low angle, warm amber light, no signs.
clips.action: Mira waves happily at the camera, then turns and walks up the path toward the fort. Camera: slow crane up beside her revealing the towers and mountains.
clips.sound: Soft breeze, distant birds, warm heritage music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Sandy courtyard between two round mud towers of the fort: her little brother (small white kandura) hides behind one tower; Mira tiptoes toward it with a finger on her lips and a playful smile, face clearly visible. 9:16 medium-wide, golden light.
clips.action: Mira peeks around the tower and finds her brother; both burst into laughter and hug. Camera: smooth arc around the tower following Mira.
clips.sound: Light footsteps on sand, playful gentle music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: غمّيضة بين أبراج قلعة الفجيرة 😄 وجبال الحجر تطالع! الحلقة الياية: أقدم مسجد للحين يصلّون فيه… تعرفون كم عمره؟ 🕌

episodes.title: ميرا في أقدم مسجد
lines: مسجد البدية بالفجيرة، أقدم مسجد في الإمارات للحين يصلّون فيه، وله أربع قباب.
وداخله عمود واحد شايل القباب كلها… مكان هادي يريّح القلب.

clips.scene: Morning at Al Bidyah Mosque: a small square mud-and-stone mosque with four low rounded domes at the foot of a rocky hill topped by two old watchtowers, the sea glimpsed nearby. Mira stands in front beside Mama (black abaya and shayla). 9:16 wide, soft clear light, no signs.
clips.action: Mira looks up at the four domes, then slips off her shoes neatly by the door and steps inside with Mama. Camera: slow push-in toward the small arched doorway.
clips.sound: Gentle sea breeze, morning birds; no music, no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Inside the tiny mosque: plain whitewashed walls, small arched windows letting in soft beams of light, a plain red carpet, one thick round pillar in the center holding up four small domes. Mira sits quietly near the pillar, face clearly visible. 9:16, peaceful light, no books, inscriptions or writing.
clips.action: Mira looks up slowly at the domes curving from the single pillar, places her palm gently on it and closes her eyes peacefully. Camera: slow tilt up from Mira along the pillar to the domes.
clips.sound: Peaceful quiet room tone, faint distant birds, soft breeze; no music, no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: أقدم مسجد في الإمارات للحين يصلّون فيه، عمره أكثر من ٥٠٠ سنة 🕌 أربع قباب وعمود واحد! الحلقة الياية: سلحفاة تسلّم على ميرا 🐢

episodes.title: ميرا والسلحفاة
lines: بحر العقة في الفجيرة صافي وايد… تشوف المرجان والسمك من فوق!
وسلحفاة بحرية طلّعت راسها جنب القارب، كأنها تقول: هلا ميرا!

clips.scene: Al Aqah coast, Fujairah: crystal-clear turquoise water over coral and rocks, a small rocky island offshore, rugged mountains along the shore. Mira sits in a small unmarked wooden boat in a plain orange life vest; Baba (modest Emirati man, white kandura and ghutra) sits at the stern. 9:16 medium-wide, bright sun, no text.
clips.action: Mira leans over the side and looks down through the clear water at colorful fish darting over the coral, her reflection rippling. Camera: slow tilt down from Mira over the side into the clear water.
clips.sound: Gentle waves on the hull, seagulls, light airy music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Close shot at the boat's side: calm clear water with a green sea turtle swimming up near the surface; Mira leans over the side with both hands on the edge, plain orange life vest on. 9:16, sparkling sunlight, no text.
clips.action: The turtle lifts its head above the water for a moment; Mira gasps, waves softly at it and smiles as it glides away. Camera: slow push-in from the turtle to Mira's delighted face.
clips.sound: Soft splash, waves, warm gentle music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: سلحفاة طلعت تسلّم على ميرا في بحر الفجيرة 🐢💙 الحلقة الياية: جبال خورفكان لاصقة في البحر… لا تفوتكم!

episodes.title: ميرا في خورفكان
lines: خورفكان في الشارقة! الجبال لاصقة في البحر، منظر خيال!
نزلنا البحر وجمعت صدف ويا أخوي الصغير… باچر نرجع أبوظبي!

clips.scene: High mountain viewpoint above Khor Fakkan, late afternoon: rugged brown mountains curving around a deep blue bay, a long sandy beach below. Mira stands at a stone railing in three-quarter side view, face clearly visible, breeze moving her abaya gently, the bay beside her. 9:16 medium-wide, warm light, no signs or text.
clips.action: Mira leans on the railing, slowly takes in the view from mountains to sea, then turns to the camera with an amazed smile. Camera: slow arc from her side toward the front, keeping the bay behind her.
clips.sound: Mountain wind, distant waves, uplifting soft music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Khor Fakkan beach at sunset: soft golden sand, small gentle waves, mountains silhouetted behind. Mira and her little brother (small white kandura) kneel on the sand beside a tiny pile of seashells. 9:16 medium shot, pink-orange sky.
clips.action: Mira picks up a pearly shell and holds it to her ear; both siblings giggle as a small wave washes near their knees. Camera: slow low dolly along the sand toward them.
clips.sound: Gentle waves, soft sea breeze, warm sunset music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: جبال خورفكان تحضن البحر 🌊 وميرا جمعت الصدف ويا أخوها! الحلقة الياية والأخيرة: اليوم الوطني في أبوظبي 🇦🇪

episodes.title: ميرا واليوم الوطني
episodes.topic: احتفال اليوم الوطني على كورنيش أبوظبي — أبوظبي
lines: اليوم الوطني! كورنيش أبوظبي كله أحمر وأخضر وأبيض وأسود.
سبع إمارات زرتها كلها… وكلها بيت واحد. كل عام والإمارات بخير!

clips.scene: Abu Dhabi Corniche, National Day dusk: palms wrapped in red, green, white and black lights, plain UAE flags (red vertical band, green-white-black stripes) waving, the sea behind, no banners, posters or portraits. Mira walks with Baba (white kandura, ghutra), Mama (black abaya, shayla) and her little brother, holding a small flag. 9:16, no text.
clips.action: Mira waves the small flag high and skips ahead along the promenade, her family following with smiles. Camera: smooth tracking shot moving backward ahead of her.
clips.sound: Festive gentle ambience, sea breeze, joyful soft patriotic-style music; no speech, no vocals.

clips.scene: Night on the Corniche beach: Mira stands in front in three-quarter view holding her small flag, with Baba (white kandura and ghutra), Mama and grandmother Yaddoh (black abayas and shaylas) and her little brother (small white kandura) beside her, the dark sky over the sea behind them ready for fireworks. 9:16 medium-wide, no text.
clips.action: Fireworks bloom in red, green, white and gold over the sea; Mira looks up, raises her flag and turns to the camera beaming as the family hugs together. Camera: slow pull-back revealing the fireworks-filled sky above the family.
clips.sound: Soft firework booms, gentle waves, uplifting warm music; no speech, no vocals.

episodes.caption: سبع إمارات… وقلب واحد 🇦🇪 ميرا خلّصت رحلتها في اليوم الوطني! شو تبون ميرا تكتشف في الموسم الياي؟ قولوا لنا 👇
